column1: # Sealed by scripts/seal-secrets.sh from secrets.local/<name>.env (gitignored) into sealed/<name>.sealedsecret.yaml.
# Checked by scripts/k8s-validate.sh (prod-sealed, secrets-manifest, --require-sealed). Optional secrets are consumed
# only through `optional: true` refs. A key ending in `?` may be empty (still required to be present): an empty LLM key
# disables that provider, an empty OIDC secret goes with GOOGLE_LOGIN=0. web-secrets has no SEPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
